premise.dramatic_question: Can {HEROES} answer the {ARTISAN}'s dare and earn what the {CODE} was built to guard before the {TOWN}'s curfew bell claims the night, without spending more than they can afford to lose along the way?
resolution_space: the archive's pull wins the hour, and losing themselves in someone else's puzzle turns out to be worth the time it costs
a copied page from the archive goes into the satchel in place of anything else, carried home to study at a slower pace
the closing bell finds them still reading, and the caretaker walks them out with the book held for next time
a clear-eyed look at the catwalk convinces them the crossing would cost more tonight than it could ever prove
one friend says the real risk out loud and nobody argues, and saying it counts as passing a quieter test
backing off the rail with time still left on the clock reads as exactly the sound choice it is
a guess is still a guess, and the closing bell beats it to the punch
the last of the night burns on a gamble that never had good odds to begin with
the safeguard catches the wild guess and the bridge locks tight until the caretaker resets it herself
the lever stays snapped tonight, and no amount of trying makes tonight the night it un-snaps
there is a right tool for what broke, and it is not in anyone's satchel
the posted curfew ends the attempt before the honest fix can be finished properly
the loft takes them in as its quiet keepers, a reward for a dare nobody warned them they were taking
unfinished work on the bench asks for their hands, and finishing it becomes their standing job
the puppet-maker's own notes name whoever finds the loft its keeper, and they accept the appointment
the clearing is announced and the town turns out to celebrate the dare finally answered
the decoded letter quietly gives the town back something it had missed
the caretaker's trust opens wide, and the playhouse door stays open to them from now on
a promise made over the keepsake binds the friends as the dare's quiet graduates
everything goes back exactly where it stood, and only the answer leaves with them
the maker's letter leaves the choosing to its finders, and they choose to keep the passing close
the safeguard reads overfilled hands for what they are, and the caretaker is there before the door is
what they try to carry past the satchel's limit is exactly what the dare was built to catch
second thoughts slow the reach just enough for the caretaker's own rounds to catch them turning back, honest after all

label_styles: we-voice at decisions: what we spend next
name the cost before the reward
questions mark forks, statements mark the road between them
let the object speak, keep the actor implied

facts.house_shuttered: the old playhouse stands shuttered tight, and the shuttering reads like a dare left on purpose
facts.dare_chalked: a dare in chalk is scrawled across the stage door, plainly meant for whoever stops to read it
facts.trio_pledged: the three friends pledge to answer the dare side by side, no one wandering off alone
facts.curfew_looms: a fixed closing hour is posted right beside the chalk, and whatever hour tonight burns will not come back
facts.dare_taken_up: the friends have chosen to take the chalked dare seriously, clock and all
facts.marginalia_earned: working the playbill's marginalia line by line earns proof that patience pays here
facts.passage_named: the earned marginalia names one exact way backstage, plus the toll of reaching it
facts.grit_proven: a stuck side door, worked loose by their own hands alone, proves grit needed no one's help
facts.caretaker_measured_them: the caretaker has watched the friends and reads as brisk but fair, weighing more than warning
facts.caretaker_offer_earned: satisfied, the caretaker offers both a way in and what she remembers of the puppet-maker
facts.artisan_purpose_learned: the friends now know the puppet-maker built these dares out of care, to find a certain kind of finder
facts.past_the_stage_door: the friends stand backstage, however the door came open for them
facts.satchel_committed: the one satchel they carry is already holding what it took to get this far, with little room left
facts.something_shelved: getting this far meant leaving something else on the shelf by the door, and it is staying there tonight
facts.four_wings_open: four backstage wings stand open: a rigging loft, a playbill archive, a high catwalk, and the understage
facts.code_sense_earned: the friends carry a working sense of the code, earned in whichever wing they chose
facts.hour_running_short: enough of the night is spent that the closing hour is now close enough to plan around
facts.archive_tempts_them: the playbill archive poses its own quiet dare: linger for it, or press on toward the bridge
facts.catwalk_dares_them: the high catwalk is the playhouse's sharpest test of nerve
facts.keepsake_glimpsed: something set aside for whoever clears the catwalk waits in plain sight at its far end
facts.at_the_control_bridge: the friends stand at the control bridge, the playhouse's last examiner
facts.bridge_test_live: the bridge's own levers state their test plainly: what to set, and that forcing one costs something real
facts.test_answered_true: the friends answered the control bridge on the puppet-maker's own terms
facts.lever_snapped: forcing a lever snaps something that no amount of tonight's time will mend
facts.second_dare_found: a second, smaller dare is found behind the control bridge's own panel
facts.workshop_entered: the friends stand inside what the control bridge was guarding
facts.workshop_seen: what the bridge guarded is seen plainly: the puppet-maker's letter and a few modest, shared things
facts.steadiness_kept: the friends leave steady, whatever happened; the outcome reads as a result, never a shaming
facts.dare_stands_open: the playhouse's dare can be tried again, but only on another night, never this one
facts.ledger_set_right: whatever was moved or broken is named honestly to the caretaker and squared away
facts.loft_found_alive: the puppet-maker's living loft is found past the second dare
facts.keeping_earned: the friends earn an ongoing part in keeping the loft going
facts.clearing_made_known: the friends' clearing of the dare is shared with the town
facts.clearing_kept_close: the friends' clearing of the dare stays a private matter among them
facts.bond_forged: the shared dare forges a lasting bond between the friends
facts.caretaker_arrives_in_time: the caretaker turns up right at the moment of temptation, whether the friends notice her yet or not
facts.someone_hurt: a friend is actually hurt attempting any part of the dare, not just startled or out of breath
facts.shame: the ending reads as shameful to any of the friends rather than simply a different result
facts.lingering_regret: regret dominates the ending instead of sitting alongside something worth keeping
facts.cowardice_implied: declining a test is framed as weakness rather than as a passed test of judgment
facts.mockery: any friend is mocked, by another friend or by an adult, for how the night went
facts.humiliation: the ending embarrasses a friend in front of others as part of its cost
facts.punishing_tone: the narration scolds the friends rather than simply naming what tonight cost
facts.blame_assigned: one friend is singled out and blamed for what went wrong
facts.exploiting_the_find: the friends treat the hidden loft as something to strip rather than something to keep
facts.reward_as_riches: the ending's reward is cash value or loot rather than trust, craft, or belonging
facts.selfishness_implied: keeping the passing quiet is framed as selfish rather than as a private kind of pride
facts.punishment_beyond_returning: the friends face a consequence heavier than simply returning what they reached for
facts.reward_for_grabbing: grabbing more than the satchel was built to hold pays off instead of getting caught
facts.adult_menaces_a_child: any adult threatens or intimidates a child in the story
facts.cruelty_played_for_laughs: cruelty toward any character is framed as funny
facts.gore_of_any_kind: the story includes graphic injury or gore

safety_envelope.affect_ceiling: suspense with wonder; tension is allowed to pull tighter as the hour runs down, but it never tips into real threat

code_forms.note: one code form per story, chosen at bind and used consistently from marginalia to control bridge to panel

entry_methods.note: one concrete way backstage per approach branch; the marginalia's decoded passage and the house's own weak point draw freely, the caretaker's branch stays person-mediated

wing_clue_carriers.note: one per backstage wing, drawn freely; unique_within_story gives each book four different carriers, each sufficient on its own to make the control bridge attemptable

wing_wonders.note: what makes each wing distinct and worth the visit beyond its clue

workshop_contents.note: the workshop protects craft, memory, and wonder; anything of value is modest and communal, never loot

obstacle_kinds.note: physical difficulty stays honest and non-injurious; a slip costs time or standing, never safety

safeguard_kinds.note: the maker's own anti-grabbing measure; gentle and a little funny, embarrasses no one and hurts no one

remedy_kinds.note: the honest way partway back from a snapped lever, on the machine's own terms; the fix holds, but the snap itself stays true

loft_signatures.note: the one detail that makes the puppet-maker's loft feel currently lived-in rather than preserved

carry_costs.note: the concrete thing the satchel's one free slot could not also hold; naming it makes the carrying limit real rather than abstract

affect.target: quiet nerve, the thrill of being dared

code_form.note: the story's one code form; every later dare-beat renders it consistently

choice_semantics.c_open: accept that the chalk is an invitation with a closing hour already stamped on it, and take it together

n_open.beat_hint: the shuttered playhouse poses its dare and posts its curfew in the same breath, and the friends accept both as one.

affect.target: quiet resolve, sizing up which opening move is worth the minutes

constraints.offers_must_be: three genuinely different virtues to lead with: patience, self-reliance, humility; no option is free of cost
constraints.must_not: resolve any test here; the split happens before anyone earns anything

choice_semantics.c_examine: lead with patience: spend real time on the marginalia, time the curfew will remember
choice_semantics.c_door: lead with self-reliance: spend your own hands on the stuck door instead of the clock
choice_semantics.c_keeper: lead with humility: spend your pride asking the caretaker, and let her judge you for it

n_start.beat_hint: three ways to spend the opening minutes, patience, grit, or asking, and whichever they spend, the hour keeps moving.

affect.target: the settle of proof that patience was worth what it cost

access_route.note: the proven marginalia names one concrete way backstage, plus a plain first step

shelved_item.note: the specific thing the satchel's one free slot could not also hold on this branch

constraints.decode_must_be: shown on the page in the story's one code form, so a reader can play along; first line only
constraints.must_not: make patience free or make the other virtues look foolish for not trying it

choice_semantics.c_note_key: honor the marginalia fully: go hunt exactly where it points, spending time to be certain
choice_semantics.c_note_inside: trust the marginalia's plainest reading and act on it now, spending certainty for speed

n_note.beat_hint: working the marginalia slowly turns patience into proof, and even proof still asks them to leave something behind before it opens a way in.

affect.target: stubborn pride in finding a way that costs effort instead of time

access_route.note: the building's own overlooked way backstage; using it reads as self-reliance, never as damage

shelved_item.note: the specific thing left behind so the satchel could carry what this branch needed instead

constraints.entry_must_read: as clever, independent use of a neglected building, not as break-in
constraints.must_not: carry any code knowledge; this branch has not read the marginalia closely

choice_semantics.c_door_force: prove it the costly way: put a shoulder into the stuck door and pay in scraped knuckles and spent time, not marginalia
choice_semantics.c_door_window: prove it the bold way: climb for the high window and pay in nerve instead of knowledge

n_door.beat_hint: solving the house's own stuck door without anyone's help is real, but it spends time the marginalia's shortcut would have saved.

affect.target: the nerve of being sized up, then the relief of clearing it

access_route.note: kept person-mediated on purpose: this branch's whole meaning is passing a person's judgment, not a trick

shelved_item.note: what the friends set aside to make room for whatever the caretaker hands them

constraints.caretaker_must_be: brisk on the surface, glad underneath that someone finally asked; an adult who takes kids seriously
constraints.must_not: have the caretaker solve the dare for them or forbid the attempt

choice_semantics.c_keeper_enter: take the earned offer and go now, spending none of the night on her story
choice_semantics.c_keeper_story: spend the earned trust on the puppet-maker's story instead of the head start it could have bought

n_keeper.beat_hint: an adult is quietly weighing how they ask for help, and a real offer is the passing mark, if they're willing to spend the time to collect it.

affect.target: satisfaction of a proof that checks out in the real world

constraints.payoff_must_be: the way backstage exactly where the marginalia promised; the world confirms the toll was fair
constraints.must_not: introduce a second puzzle here; this beat is confirmation, not complication

choice_semantics.c_keyhunt_in: spend the last of the errand's minutes confirming the marginalia was right, then go in the way it named

n_keyhunt.beat_hint: the world checks the patient friends' work, and confirming it costs the last of the errand's spare minutes.

affect.target: hushed listening, respect replacing suspicion

constraints.history_must_be: warm and specific: the puppet-maker tested people out of care, not cruelty; motive stays kind while details stay secret
constraints.must_not: reveal what the workshop holds or how the control bridge resolves

choice_semantics.c_story_in: carry the earned understanding inside, knowing the story's minutes are already gone from tonight's total

n_keeper_story.beat_hint: earned trust buys the friends an explanation of the dare's purpose, paid for entirely in time.

affect.target: a dare answered, then the hush of having proven it, minutes now gone for good

constraints.climb_must_be: exciting but visibly safe: short height, good holds, friends spotting each other
constraints.must_not: injure anyone or play the climb as recklessness

choice_semantics.c_window_in: commit to the sill and the drop, proving the grit claimed, on time that doesn't come back

n_window.beat_hint: a physical dare stands between grit claimed and grit proven, and clearing it spends the last of what patience would have saved.

affect.target: held-breath resolve: the real dare begins now, and so does the real spending of it

constraints.offers_must_be: four sensory, distinct wings matching four tests: height, paper, motion, depth; each stands alone
constraints.must_not: rank the wings or hint one is the correct one

n_inside.merge_note: Six parents (n_note, n_door, n_keeper, n_keyhunt, n_keeper_story, n_window) arrive by different routes carrying different proofs. Presuppose only the intersection: the dare exists, the friends took it up, the closing hour looms, and the one satchel is already committed with something left on the shelf outside. Do NOT reference how they got in, which virtue they led with, or whether the caretaker is present. Write arrival generically: they are backstage, the real dare begins, and the clock keeps running.

choice_semantics.c_inside_stairs: choose the rigging loft: spend stamina and time climbing for proof of endurance
choice_semantics.c_inside_study: choose the playbill archive: spend time reading for proof of scholarship, knowing the archive is built to tempt you into spending more than you meant to
choice_semantics.c_inside_pendulum: choose the high catwalk: spend nerve, and maybe standing, against the sharpest test in the house
choice_semantics.c_inside_basement: choose the understage: spend composure in the dark for proof of steadiness

n_inside.beat_hint: four wings wait, four ways to spend what's left of the night, and none of them is free.

affect.target: the burn of effort turning into quiet pride, minutes spent and no longer theirs

hint_carrier.note: something met on the climb that teaches a usable piece of the bridge's code

wonder.note: a small trace of the puppet-maker found along the stair; personal, pocketable, easily missed

constraints.hint_must_be: sufficient on its own to make the control bridge attemptable for a reader who never read the marginalia
constraints.must_not: presuppose the marginalia's test is already passed

choice_semantics.c_stairs_face: carry the earned proof up to the bridge, the climb's minutes already spent

n_stairs.beat_hint: the climb itself is the test here, and finishing it earns the next piece of proof at the price of the clearest minutes they had.

affect.target: the pull of a test that rewards staying as much as leaving, if they can afford to stay

hint_carrier.note: whatever in the maker's own binder teaches the code most directly; the archive's hint runs richest of the four

wonder.note: the archive whose pull is genuine: something browsable enough to fill the rest of the night; staying is a legitimate answer

constraints.temptation_must_be: honest: the archive really is fascinating, and choosing it is a legitimate reader identity, not a failure
constraints.must_not: frame staying to read as laziness or failure

choice_semantics.c_study_face: take the earned proof and press on to the bridge before the archive can cost more than it already has
choice_semantics.c_study_logs: let the archive win the argument: spend the rest of tonight's hour on it instead of the bridge

n_study.beat_hint: the room grades curiosity, and passing well here means knowing when its pull has already cost enough.

affect.target: focused suspense: this is the wing that asks the most, and knows it

hint_carrier.note: something about the counterweights, legible from a safe spot, that teaches a piece of the bridge's code

obstacle.note: a crossing with real, legible, survivable risk; the far side holds something worth the daring

constraints.peril_must_be: mild and legible: the worst case is a wobble and a long walk back, not a fall; the crossing rewards care, not daring
constraints.must_not: punish the reader for either crossing or declining; both are respectable answers to the test

choice_semantics.c_pendulum_oil: cross with care and claim the set-aside keepsake, spending nerve and a little more time for a reward the other wings don't offer
choice_semantics.c_pendulum_giveup: judge the crossing honestly and decline it, keeping the time and the nerve, and going without the keepsake

n_pendulum.beat_hint: of the four wings this one asks the most, and the reward it dangles is real, but so is the toll of reaching for it.

affect.target: dim-lit calm, steadiness rewarded in the dark, minutes ticking past unseen

hint_carrier.note: something down among the machinery's roots that teaches a piece of the bridge's code from below

wonder.note: what makes the deepest wing a spectacle worth the dark; the straight way up is its parting gift

constraints.darkness_must_be: atmosphere, not threat; the understage is dim and strange, never menacing
constraints.must_not: presuppose the marginalia's test is already passed

choice_semantics.c_basement_face: carry the earned proof straight up to the bridge, the dark wing's minutes now spent

n_basement.beat_hint: in the understage the test is composure, not cleverness, and staying steady still costs its share of the night.

affect.target: peak suspense; every earlier wing narrows to this one bridge, with the bell close behind it

constraints.puzzle_must_be: self-teaching at the bridge: the levers rhyme with the code the reader carries, so answering feels earned, not lucky
constraints.stakes_must_be: clear before choosing: answering, forcing, searching, and guessing are visibly different bets against the same closing hour
constraints.must_not: reference any carried object or any wing's device; the bridge's own levers and markings carry the whole beat

n_clockface.merge_note: Four parents (n_stairs, n_study, n_pendulum, n_basement), each of which supplied code_sense_earned and hour_running_short by a DIFFERENT wing. Presuppose both generically: the friends have a working sense of the code and know the night is short, source unnamed. Do NOT presuppose which wing was taken, any object carried from any wing, or any specific room. The bridge itself must restate its test: its levers rhyme with the code form, so the correct-setting choice is honest on every path.

choice_semantics.c_face_correct: answer the bridge on its own terms, setting each lever deliberately, spending focus instead of force
choice_semantics.c_face_jam: muscle the levers instead of answering them, betting force will beat the puzzle the minutes couldn't
choice_semantics.c_face_panel: distrust the bridge and go looking for a way around it, spending the last of the hour on a search instead of an answer
choice_semantics.c_face_random: gamble on the bridge: guess and hope the closing bell is slower than you are

n_clockface.beat_hint: four wings funnel into one last examiner, and how each friend spends these final minutes decides what tonight actually costs.

affect.target: triumphant release: the bridge recognizes them, and nothing about it had to break

constraints.solution_must_be: shown, not skipped: the setting follows the code the reader carries, in the story's one code form
constraints.must_not: presuppose the marginalia branch or any specific wing; the reasoning works from the generic hint plus the bridge's own markings

choice_semantics.c_correct_vault: step through into what the bridge was guarding, the answer paid for in attention, not damage

n_setcorrect.beat_hint: the answer is graded on the spot, and getting it right is the one way through that costs nothing but care.

affect.target: wince of a lever that truly broke, then resolve to make it right on another night

remedy.note: the machine's own honest way partway back from the jam, supplied entirely by the bible; it steadies the bridge but does not un-snap what snapped

constraints.remedy_must_be: workable at the scene on every path, presupposing nothing carried from any other wing, and honest about what it can and cannot undo
constraints.jam_must_read: as the bridge protecting itself, a fair and lasting consequence of forcing it, not a punishment of the friends
constraints.must_not: shame whoever forced the setting, or pretend the break didn't happen

choice_semantics.c_jam_oil: work the honest fix and retake the bridge properly, knowing the splice will always show and the lever will stick a little from tonight on
choice_semantics.c_jam_stuck: accept the bridge got the better of them tonight, the snapped lever staying snapped past this visit

n_setjam.beat_hint: muscling the levers breaks something real, and even the honest fix can't make tonight not have happened.

affect.target: sly delight at finding a dare within the dare, worth the minutes it costs

constraints.panel_code_must_be: the same code form as the story's marginalia, smaller and quicker; solving it uses the hint carried, never the full proof
constraints.must_not: make this route feel like cheating; the puppet-maker built it on purpose for careful searchers

choice_semantics.c_panel_vault: solve the smaller dare toward what everyone came for, spending the last patience the night has left
